name: Wawrzyniec Otto-Trąmpczyński

events.note: Wojciech's nephew and ward; the division of Trąbczyn with their uncle Wojciech was made on the Monday after Jubilate Sunday 1591.

notes: Named among the four nephews and wards of 1584-1591 but not in his mother's settlement of 1596; his sonship of Jan rests on being one of Wojciech's four nephews.
